facts.claim: Monthly churn of 5% to 12% is typical for mobile subscription apps, with the best holding under 5%
facts.excerpt: For mobile subscription apps, monthly churn of 5-12% is typical, with the best apps under 5%.

facts.claim: Between 20% and 40% of total subscription churn is payment failure rather than cancellation
facts.excerpt: Companies that measure only active cancellations miss the 20 to 40% of total churn driven by payment failures.

facts.claim: Median first-month renewal runs 42% to 61% by category, with Business highest at 61% and Social & Lifestyle lowest at 42%
facts.excerpt: Median first renewal rate ranges from 42-61% between categories; Business achieves 61%, Social & Lifestyle 42%.

facts.claim: Median recovery of involuntary churn is 47.6%, with top performers reaching 70% to 85%
facts.excerpt: The industry median recovery rate for involuntary churn is 47.6%, with top-performer recovery reaching 70-85%.

facts.claim: More than 120 million UPI Autopay mandates are created every month in India
facts.source_title: UPI Autopay vs Card e-Mandates: 2026 Decision Guide
facts.excerpt: Over 120 million UPI Autopay mandates are created every month in India, supporting SIPs, OTT subscriptions and insurance renewals.

facts.claim: India's 2021 card e-mandate rules pushed card subscription failure rates above 20% in some categories
facts.source_title: UPI Autopay vs Card e-Mandates: 2026 Decision Guide
facts.excerpt: The mandate requiring extra authentication for card payments above Rs 5,000 caused failure rates to spike to 20%+ in some categories, accelerating UPI Autopay adoption.
